name: Deco Sauna
description:
Conceived by acclaimed Finnish designer Esa Vapaavuori, Deco’s inviting aesthetics and intelligent comfort can be formatted to almost any sauna room layout. Clean, fresh and smart, Deco is a marriage of tradition and innovation you will look forward to taking comfort in daily.

Outside Dimensions: Depth 72”, Width 84”, Height: 84”
Middle-platform bench / deck
Includes low-voltage backrest lighting, fixed or movable benches, deluxe full-length backrest, headrest, duckboards, and bench skirts
Bronze all-glass front wall
